reuse.why: Builds the schedule with the existing recurConfigToRSchedule and recurConfigToExcludedRules (which already drop daily weekend occurrences) and adjusts with getDateWithSkippedWeekend, as getUpcomingDates does.

duplication.why: The RSchedule construction and the skipWeekend ? getDateWithSkippedWeekend(...) : date mapping are repeated from getUpcomingDates rather than shared; the copy is small.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app and is registered alongside it, with the rules kept in shared/schedules.

scope.why: Adds only the handler, its registration, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short, readable handler that inherits the shared weekend rules; the fixed 3-day margin is tied to the current at-most-2-day adjustment and is commented.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the shared schedule-building and weekend-adjustment helpers.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated occurrence-adjustment mapping is an open copy of getUpcomingDates' mapping, not a disguised one.
